The problem

## You only see a fraction of your options

Job boards leave you to search thousands of roles. Recruiters and your network cover only a corner of the market. So some of the best jobs never reach you.

Jack gets to know your career, what matters to you and what would make a move worthwhile. Then he searches millions of jobs, bringing you the ones worth your time.

## FAQs

### Is Jack just another chatbot?

No. Jack searches millions of jobs for you, then makes direct introductions to hiring managers when there’s a fit. He doesn’t give generic career advice: he works from your story.

### Will I get spammed with irrelevant roles?

No. If Jack brings you something, it’s because it looks like a real step up. You tell him yes or no, and he gets sharper with each response.

### What if I’m not actively looking?

That’s when Jack is most useful. He searches while you focus on your current job, so you hear about the role you’d actually move for, not a stream of sideways moves.

### Does Jack work for companies?

No. Jack works for you. Jill works with companies. When they agree there’s a mutual fit, they introduce you. Jack has no incentive to push you toward the wrong role.

### How long before I see something?

Most people see roles worth considering within ten minutes of the first conversation. Introductions take longer. They only happen when a company wants to meet you too.

## Talk to Jack for free

We’re paid by companies, and only when you get hired.
